title: Li Fire Suppresses an Old Acquaintance
summary: In the Holy City, Ye Fan finds Old Jiang and Tingting running an inn near the Jiang family, and learns that some in the Jiang clan no longer believe the Divine King Jiang Taixu is alive after 4,000 years of searching. To pass on the news secretly, he spreads it as rumour and sends the Jiang family a letter carrying the Dou secret that Jiang Taixu taught him under Purple Mountain. The Jiang Holy Lord and Jiang Yun (both Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) recognise the Dou secret, and Jiang Yun swears as the Divine King's direct descendant to unseal the clan's ancestral weapon and bring him back. Jiang Yichen (Four Poles), who once hunted Ye Fan, comes after the Mother Qi cauldron and the Dou secret. Ye Fan beats him, but spares him when he claims Tingting's Taiyin body depends on his medicine, and extracts a Heavenly Life Fruit for her; Tingting in turn tells Ye Fan the scroll she gave him is the Hengyu Scripture. Narration says the Jiang family rescues Jiang Taixu from Purple Mountain at great cost, waking something ancient there, and his old enemies gather to wipe out the Jiang family. Ye Fan arrives at the Jiang gates asking to see the Divine King.
